title: Broken Release-Acquire Chains (Lack of Transitivity)
pattern: Attempting to establish a multi-hop memory visibility chain across CPUs, but utilizing non-atomic plain writes on intermediate nodes.
why_bad: The transitive visibility property of release-acquire chains requires every intermediate step to pair an acquire-load with a release-store on the *same* variable. Breaking the chain with a plain store on CPU 1 prevents the memory visibility of CPU 0's writes from propagating to CPU 2.
detection: A sequence of thread-to-thread communication steps where at least one intermediate step does not pair an acquire load with a release store.
counterexample: Properly chaining all steps using acquire-release.
